title: TemplateEnvelopeV1 structural contract
description: Generated from all reachable TypeScript DTO fields. Opaque bags are identified; this is not an import, safety, or visual acceptance verdict.

authoring.description: Optional authoring metadata for AI-driven template creation and easy editing

path.description: For builtin: path relative to templates/previews/

blobKey.description: For user templates: IndexedDB blob key

dataUrl.description: Data URL for inline small previews

fadeColor.description: For fade transitions: color to fade through (default: black)

wipeAngle.description: For wipe transitions: angle in degrees (for diagonal wipes)

durationMs.description: Duration of the camera transition in milliseconds

strokeMaterial.description: Visual stroke material; independent from the hand and tool sprites.

strokeMaterialFollowsBoard.description: False once this scene explicitly opts out of board-suggested materials.

strokeColor.description: Optional default foreground for new scene draw content.

id.description: Local ID inside template (will be remapped on apply)

textBoxSizing.description: Portable native Text box policy; absent legacy values remain fixed.

props.description: Flexible props bag (v1); v2 should tighten per type

animationStart.description: Animation settings (v1 units: milliseconds; runtime converts to seconds)

timing.description: Optional scene-local visible range, in milliseconds. Visual-only in Phase 1.

additionalProperties.description: Opaque unknown data; runtime validation remains authoritative.

overrideTextHash.description: Hash of source text when overrides were authored; later edits retain global intent but suspend stale overrides.

startMs.description: Scene-local visible range start, in milliseconds.

endMs.description: Scene-local visible range end, in milliseconds.

endBehavior.description: Ordinary content holds its final frame. Temporary authored content may opt into hiding at endMs.

cameraFollowTargetId.description: Follow-object target (template-local object id; remapped on apply).

timingOwned.description: Defaults to true. False permits semantic references from other beats.

id.description: Local track id inside template (will be remapped on apply).

ownerId.description: Object id that owns this track (will be remapped on apply).

id.description: Local key id inside template (will be remapped on apply).

trackId.description: Track id this key belongs to (will be remapped on apply).

easing.description: Legacy v1 field. Runtime DrawStep does not support easing and apply ignores it.

mode.description: Camera mode: none | hero | wide | lock

transition.description: Transition speed: quick (0.35s) | smooth (0.55s) | number (custom seconds)

framing.description: Optional UI framing value for round-tripping Tight/Medium/Wide.

startOffsetSec.description: Optional camera start offset in seconds relative to the draw step start.

holdSec.description: Optional hold duration in seconds before reverting.

strokeMaterialId.description: Optional default for newly authored drawable objects.

assetId.description: For builtin: asset ID in builtin library

filename.description: For imported: original filename or path

objectRoles.description: Object role classifications for content/decoration separation

assetChoices.description: Asset choices from the approved manifest

primarySlotCount.description: Number of primary edit points (should be 3-7 for good UX)

label.description: Human-readable label for the edit form

objectIds.description: ObjectDTO IDs this slot maps to (one slot can control multiple objects)

propKey.description: The property key on the object props to modify (default: 'text' for text, 'src' for image)

defaultValue.description: Default value (used when creating new instances from template)

group.description: Group name (for organizing related slots in the edit form)

maxChars.description: Max character count for text slots

minChars.description: Min character count for text slots

aspectRatio.description: Allowed aspect ratio for image slots (e.g. '16:9', '1:1')

allowedCategories.description: Allowed icon categories for icon slots

multiline.description: Render a multiline editor and preserve newline characters for text slots.

required.description: Whether this slot is required (default: true)

lockedByDefault.description: Whether the object should be locked from editing by default

description.description: Human-readable description of this object's purpose

assetId.description: Asset ID from the asset manifest

objectId.description: ObjectDTO.id where this asset is used
